body:
TotalEnergies and KKR have plans to add 700 megawatts of renewables to a 50/50 joint venture the firms launched in the United States in 2025, reflecting an enterprise value of $1.2 billion for the portfolio.

The portfolio already holds 1.4 gigawatts.

The firms said the transaction covers a portfolio of three utility-scale solar assets located in Texas and in Ohio, which are expected to reach their commercial operation dates by first quarter 2027. The electricity produced by these assets is already sold to third parties or will be marketed by TotalEnergies, which also will continue to operate the assets after the transaction is complete.
